source_semantics.request: The Sites bulk-action bar exposes Delete selected through RequestBulkDeleteAsync as the pre-confirmation destructive request boundary.
source_semantics.separation: The source keeps RequestBulkDeleteAsync distinct from ConfirmBulkDeleteAsync; requesting deletion does not itself perform the destructive mutation.
source_semantics.confirmation: Actual bulk deletion remains behind the separate destructive confirmation dialog and ConfirmBulkDeleteAsync handler.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/sites-bulk-delete-control.tsx binds AIMW-SYNC-7C3B0E834E to the real Delete selected request button and opens the existing confirmation dialog through requestBulkDelete without issuing DELETE.
laravel_adaptation.permission_visibility: The control renders only when the authoritative FrontendContext includes sites.manage (or wildcard) and a real sites API endpoint.
laravel_adaptation.destructive_boundary: The existing confirmation control AIMW-BILL-337E4FF969 remains the only button that invokes mutation.mutate(selectedIds).
laravel_adaptation.tenant_preflight: The downstream destructive endpoint remains tenant-scoped and rejects a foreign selected site with 404 before deletion.
